deep_dive.executive_summary: At $138.73 (Yahoo close 2026-08-13), our base case annual return is -3.65% per year over seven years on proof-backed component economic value $107 per share. Citigroup is a global G-SIB in mid-cycle credit conditions with standardized CET1 13.2% versus 11.6% required. FY2025 capital return to common shareholders was $17.6 billion. The four-component proof schedule sums to $107/sh base (tangible equity $97 + franchise $15 + excess capital $10 − stress reserve $15). Moat is narrow on deposit and transaction banking scale; dhando is partial at tangible book with bounded downside reserve. Propo...
